title: Chapter 664 - 664 Rich Woman; Fate!
content:
Chapter 664 - 664 Rich Woman; Fate!

Chapter 664 - 664 Rich Woman; Fate!

664 Rich Woman; Fate!

After a long time, Zhang Wenzhuo collected some of his thoughts. He opened his mouth and seemed to be hesitant.

After a while, he said, “I don’t know if it’s because of luck. Lin Fan, have you heard of buying a child?”

“Huh?” Lin Fan blinked his eyes as if he had thought of something. The strange look on his face grew even more intense.

Zhang Wenzhuo looked around again and said, “This morning, I received a message from a rich and beautiful woman who’s a surrogate mom.

“This woman has a perfect figure and face! As long as she gave birth to a child, she’ll receive ten million World Coins.

“I bought a new gaming helmet when school started. Two days ago, I gave 1,000 World Coins to Lin Fan from 1,000 years ago. I’m a little short of money now… But isn’t it bad to become a tool for reproduction?”

When Zhang Wenzhuo said this, he could not help but feel a little embarrassed.

It was as if he was struggling between ten million World Coins and letting a woman become a tool for reproduction.

Lin Fan looked at his serious expression and almost laughed out loud.

He thought to himself, ‘Sure enough, everything has its origin. However, why do these scammers always find the same person? Can’t they branch out?’

Lin Fan patted Zhang Wenzhuo’s shoulder and said earnestly, “That’s up to you to decide.

“If you encounter any trouble in the future, you can call me. Perhaps I can help you.”

“We’re classmates and roommates!” Zhang Wenzhuo said seriously. “When I become a powerful special ability user or a rich man, I’ll also help you!”

…

As the news of the joint exam spread, the whole of Jiangbei became lively.

Discussions about the joint examination could be heard everywhere. When they looked up, they could see advertisements and promotional videos about the joint examination of the three schools…

Everyone was looking forward to the wonderful performance of the three schools’ proud students.

For this reason, many people specially rushed over from other places.

All of a sudden, Jiangbei became one of the most popular tourist cities.

…

Lin Fan did not care about any of this at all.

Jiangbei University had lifted their dismissal order.

Hence, Lin Fan did not continue sleeping in the dormitory.

Instead, he went to the luxurious presidential suite of the Imperial Hotel.

That was because when he stayed in the school dormitory, it was easy for Lin Fan to think of things that happened a thousand years ago.

Unfortunately, things were different now, so it was better to choose a quiet and comfortable place to stay.

Lin Fan stood in front of the full-view window and asked, “Lil White, have you found any traces of my parents, sister, Hu Tian, Han Tian, and the others?”

Lil White apologized, “I’m sorry, Master. A thousand years ago, they seemed to have disappeared into thin air.

“The only thing that can be confirmed is that Xia Xue and Xia Bing should’ve seen them in the end.”

Lin Fan nodded his head and looked into the distance. It was as if he could see the entire world.

…

Three days passed in a flash.

After Lin Fan finished his breakfast, he strolled to Jiangbei University.

When he came to the corner of the classroom, he happened to see Zhang Wenzhuo with dark eye bags under his eyes. He could not help but ask, “You don’t seem to be in a good mental state.”

When Zhang Wenzhuo saw that it was Lin Fan, he forcefully perked up.

Then, he looked around and whispered, “Lin Fan, do you still remember the Lin Fan from a thousand years ago who sent me a message?”

Lin Fan nodded.

“He’s a fake!” Zhang Wenzhuo said.

Lin Fan’s expression did not change at all.

That was because he was the Lin Fan from a thousand years ago that the other party was talking about. The other Lin Fan was naturally fake.

“The one who wants to buy a child is the real one,” Zhang Wenzhuo continued.

When Lin Fan heard this, his calm face finally revealed a strange expression.

Buy a child?

Really?

“So, your dark circles…”

“I didn’t go to see her the day before yesterday!” Zhang Wenzhuo hurriedly said.

” I know,” Lin Fan said.

“The teacher will be here soon. Let’s go back to the classroom first.” Zhang Wenzhuo seemed to be afraid of being heard and quickly walked into the classroom.

Lin Fan looked at the way his legs went limp as he walked and could not help but want to laugh.

Since class had not started yet, the classroom was a little noisy. There was constant discussion.

“You must perform well in the joint examination of the three schools this time!”

“Of course! Chief Hu Yixiao is personally hosting it! If he takes a fancy to you, you might even become a high-ranking official in the future!”

“A high-ranking official! My dream in this life is to be an official!”

“I heard that the reason why the joint examination is suddenly held in Jiangbei was because the higher-ups think that the Lin Fan from a thousand years ago is in Jiangbei!”

“He might even watch the examination! If Lin Fan takes a fancy to anyone, it’s possible for them to become an immortal or even a god!”

“Fortunately, we have all become special ability users!”

“We must perform well!”

…

When Lin Fan heard that, he was stunned.

They had their own reasons for the joint examination of the three schools, huh?

Of course, he did not take it to heart.

At this time, Xia Xue was already sitting in her seat.

Today’s Xia Xue was more heroic than usual.

Lin Fan knew the reason.

In the past three days, many people had gone through emergency training for the joint examination.

Xia Xue was also one of them.

However, when Xia Xue saw Lin Fan, her heroic spirit completely disappeared.

What replaced it was a faint shyness.

Lin Fan smiled and said, “Xia Xue, good morning.”

“Good morning… Good morning,” Xia Xue stuttered.

At this moment, the crisp sound of the bell rang throughout Jiangbei University.

Not long after, Qin Chuan, who was wearing a white shirt, strode up to the podium.

He glanced at the students and said, “There are a total of 99,011 people in the joint examination. They’re divided into 99 groups, and each group has nearly 1,000 people! Now, I’ll announce the names in our class!”

As soon as he finished speaking, Qin Chuan waved his hand. A 3D projection appeared in front of him.

“I’m in Group 51!”

“I’m in Group 3!”

“I’m in Group 8!”

…

Soon, loud noises rang out in the class.

Many people in the class were divided into different groups.

Lin Fan, Xia Xue, and Li Dongqiang were in Group 7.

Qin Chuan gestured for everyone to be quiet before saying, “I’ve already sent the location of the competition to everyone’s communication number. After checking it, you can go to the competition venue on your own.”

The students quickly took out their foldable monitors to check and then walked out.

Li Dongqiang rubbed his nose and chuckled. “Last time, the three of us were on night watch together. I didn’t expect the three of us to be in the same group this time. It’s really fate!”

Fate?

Xia Xue did not know why, but after hearing this word, she could not help but secretly look at Lin Fan. Her pretty face immediately blushed.
